basic_details.job_title: CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR) institute CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM), Jammu, has invited applications for one Administrative Officer position on a purely temporary basis under the DHR-funded project No. GAP-3200, "Establishment of Health Technology Assessment in India (HTAIn) New Resource Centre". The consolidated pay is Rs. 40,000 per month. The essential qualification is MBA/M.Sc. with 3 years of experience in working on/or managing R&D projects. Applications are made through a Google Form and must be submitted by 13 November 2026 (Fri

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years. Age will be reckoned as on the last date of application. Relaxation in age limit will be given as per Govt. of India Rules; the notice does not list category-wise relaxation.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Administrative Officer (Code 01) MBA/M.Sc. with 3 years of experience in working on/or managing R&D projects.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form given against "How to apply" in the notice (Click here to apply) and apply for the post of Administrative Officer.
Fill in all the entries clearly in BLOCK LETTERS, exactly as entered in the Google Form.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents.
Bring the duly filled Annexure-I application form at the time of interview.

Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents may be rejected. The notice asks applicants to read the eligibility criteria, qualifications, experience, age limit and general terms and conditions before filling the form. For queries, write to [email protected].
Duly filled Annexure-I application form, to be brought at the interview.
Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents, including certificates/mark sheets for academic qualifications.
Brief abstract of thesis, if Ph.D. thesis details are given in the form.
A separate sheet with details, if the applicant has ever been dismissed/removed from service or convicted in any criminal/vigilance case.

Annexure-I asks for the post applied for, personal details, address and contact details, employment status, academic qualifications, Ph.D. thesis details (if applicable), training and certifications, employment details, relevant experience and achievements, references (who should not be relatives), additional information such as notice period and relatives working at CSIR-IIIM, and a list of enclosures, followed by a declaration and signature.
important_instructions: The number of positions may vary depending upon the project requirements at the time of interview. The Director, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised positions. Interim enquiries will not be entertained. Candidates currently working on a CSIR-IIIM project need an NOC before applying. Canvassing in any form is a ground for disqualification.

rows.details: CSIR-Indian Institute of Integrative Medicine (CSIR-IIIM), Jammu
"Establishment of Health Technology Assessment in India (HTAIn) New Resource Centre", Project No. GAP-3200
Initially till 31.03.2027; may be extended or curtailed

content_sections.heading: About CSIR-IIIM
content_sections.text: CSIR-IIIM, Jammu, is described in the notice as a premier institute working under the aegis of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), an autonomous body under the Department of Scientific & Industrial Research (DSIR), Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India. Its address is Canal Road, Jammu, Jammu & Kashmir - 180001. The advertised position is tenable at CSIR-IIIM, Jammu, and is for the HTAIn New Resource Centre, which the application form describes as supported by ICMR-Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years. Age will be reckoned as on the last date of application. Relaxation in age limit will be given as per Govt. of India Rules; the notice does not list category-wise relaxation. Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before applying for any new vacancy. Their application, candidature or selection will be considered only if the office has issued the NOC. Canvassing in any form will be treated as disqualification for the positions. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: MBA/M.Sc. with 3 years of experience in working on/or managing R&D projects.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Administrative Officer is paid Rs. 40,000/- per month (Consolidated). The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The engagement will initially be till 31.03.2027. It may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, requirements, availability of funds and the performance/conduct of the incumbent. The tenure of engagement shall be co-terminus with the project. Under no circumstances shall the total tenure exceed six years, including engagement in all CSIR labs. Performance will be reviewed periodically, and unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination without any notice or reason. The position is purely temporary and is on behalf of the sponsor. It gives the incumbent no right, implicit or explicit, to claim absorption on any post in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer Job Description
content_sections.text: Handle administrative and office-related activities of TRC. Maintain records, official correspondence and project documentation. Assist in procurement, finance coordination, logistics and organization of meetings. Support project compliance, reporting and other project-related activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form given against "How to apply" in the notice (Click here to apply) and apply for the post of Administrative Officer. Fill in all the entries clearly in BLOCK LETTERS, exactly as entered in the Google Form. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents. Apply on or before 13 November 2026. Bring the duly filled Annexure-I application form at the time of interview. Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents may be rejected. The notice asks applicants to read the eligibility criteria, qualifications, experience, age limit and general terms and conditions before filling the form. For queries, write to [email protected] . Duly filled Annexure-I application form, to be brought at the interview. Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates and documents, including certificates/mark sheets for academic qualifications. Brief abstract of thesis, if Ph.D. thesis details are given in the form. A separate sheet with details, if the applicant has ever been dismissed/removed from service or convicted in any criminal/vigilance case. Annexure-I asks for the post applied for, personal details, address and contact details, employment status, academic qualifications, Ph.D. thesis details (if applicable), training and certifications, employment details, relevant experience and achievements, references (who should not be relatives), additional information such as notice period and relatives working at CSIR-IIIM, and a list of enclosures, followed by a declaration and signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is to be done on the basis of an interview. If a large number of candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria, if required. The interview is online, through MS Teams. Candidates will have the option to interact in English or Hindi before the Selection Committee. The notice does not give the interview date. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview. On selection or empanelment, original documents including the eligibility qualification, date of birth, caste and age relaxation certificates will be verified. If any discrepancy is found, the selection/empanelment shall stand cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of positions may vary depending upon the project requirements at the time of interview. The Director, CSIR-IIIM reserves the right not to fill any or all advertised positions. Interim enquiries will not be entertained. Candidates currently working on a CSIR-IIIM project need an NOC before applying. Canvassing in any form is a ground for disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many Administrative Officer vacancies are there at CSIR-IIIM?
faq.answer: There is one position of Administrative Officer (Position Code 01). The notice adds that the number of positions may vary depending on project requirements at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 13 November 2026 (Friday).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBA/M.Sc. with 3 years of experience in working on/or managing R&D projects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years, counted as on the last date of application. Relaxation is given as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The monthly emolument is Rs. 40,000/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the CSIR-IIIM Administrative Officer post?
faq.answer: Apply through the Google Form linked in the notice, filling entries in BLOCK LETTERS and attaching self-attested copies of relevant certificates. Bring the filled Annexure-I at the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of an interview, held online through MS Teams. If many candidates apply, the Screening Committee may revisit the screening criteria, if required.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and project-based. It is initially till 31.03.2027, may be extended or curtailed, and the total tenure cannot exceed six years including engagement in all CSIR labs. It gives no right to absorption in CSIR-IIIM/CSIR.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do current CSIR-IIIM project staff need permission to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently engaged in any project at CSIR-IIIM must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) before applying, and are considered only if the office has issued it.
